title: Calorie calculator: daily calorie needs (TDEE)
description: How many calories you need a day to maintain, lose or gain weight — estimated with the Mifflin–St Jeor equation and your activity level.

options.very: Very active (physical job or training twice a day)

ui.tooLow: discuss this intake with a clinician
ui.goalsNote: Based on roughly 3,500 calories per pound of fat (7,700 per kg); in practice progress slows over time. Don’t go below {min} calories a day without medical supervision. A safe pace is 1–2 lb a week.
